name: MonarchDivider
title: Separator
summary: The standard Divider in the theme's subtle border colour.
whenToUse: Between groups of content in a stack.
whenNotToUse: Inside a List, which draws its own separators.
appearance: A hairline in the subtle border colour of the theme.
platformNotes: Named MonarchDivider on both native platforms; the web component is Separator. It is the system Divider with the theme colour drawn over it, so the axis follows the enclosing stack and there is no orientation parameter.
accessibility: Horizontal in a vertical stack and vertical in a horizontal stack, like the system divider.
edgeCases: In a horizontal stack the divider takes the full height the stack offers; constrain the stack's height.

examples.title: Horizontal
